text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Umarathon runner registration staff"...
Ah, looks
like it would overlap with
practice time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Production line at a carrot plant"...
"Cleat quality
inspection"... Hmm,
wouldn't want stiff shoulders
with a race
coming up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! "Short-Term OK! Delivering
Packages and
Smiles: UmaExpress,
Temporary Courier." This is
it! It'll even
double as training—two birds with one

stone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I might even be able to
afford a trip
to the amusement park as
next month's treat for
my sisters! ♪ Big
sister's got work to do!
